basisPolicy: The installed default's eight ordinary nationwide lists supply the fitted Camera basis. Current joint ballot labels remain whole statistical blocks; Azione and Italia Viva remain separate because selected 2026 polls distinguish them. Other source identities pool whole into an explicit unfiled historical-rest component. No count is split.
referenceSupportedPolicy: Restricted-filing and opaque special-ballot identities are reference-supported future components, not newly formed parties. At each special region their central valid shares are conditional on the current physical filing and the original paired-2022 regional valid denominator. Non-valid anchors hold the original regional baseline. Missing-profile uncertainty remains explicit. These groups are not direct C/E likelihood coordinates; their original counts remain in the pooled historical-rest likelihood. No special group is decomposed into endorsed parties.
electoratePolicy: Hold the matched original Camera-2022 common-18+ municipal electorate constant, conditionally, for both future chambers; no demographic forecast or inferred fine-geography turnout.
selectionStatus: candidate-only; default activation and predictive acceptance remain FV-08
